'''Gary Mohnsen''' won the [[1997 Yavin 4 Regionals (Charlotte)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I'm 26, originally from Tucson, Arizona, now living in Moneta, in southwestern Virginia. I work as a computer programmer. I've played Star Wars CCG for about a year and a half. One of the things I enjoy best about the game is that the player with the best cards is not necessarily the winner. Success in this game depends on skill. My favorite card is Darth Vader, and my favorite quote is 'Is the dark side stronger?.' I say, yes, it is."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/mohnsen.html Gary Mohnsen], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428010500/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/mohnsen.html Internet Archive]</ref>
